reviews.title: Great cooling power and value.
reviews.comment:
Great fan that you should definitely try if your case has the space.
Comes with thermal paste, though it does not seem of the highest quality and is very thick. I’m not sure how to compare it though.
Each fan is wired separately, but it comes with an adapter to merge the connectors so it can plug into the CPU fan 4-pin.
Setting the fan onto the bracket was tricky to line up, but once that was done, it was a smooth install.
reviews.author: Mark Glen

reviews.author: Amar

reviews.title: High-performance CPU cooler that outperforms  360 AIO -  Intel 13700KF
reviews.comment:
It outperforms my previous 360 AIO cooler (Cougar Poseidon GT 360), keeping my 13700KF below 90°C with a 31k Cinebench score, and it's super quiet!
I’m never going back to water cooling. This cooler achieves everything and more than any AIO I’ve used. My Intel 13700KF reached 270W without any issues.
Regarding RAM height, this cooler supports up to 60mm. I had no problems with relatively tall RAM like the Corsair Vengeance RGB PRO (51mm). You just need to install one of the fans a bit higher—simple as that.
reviews.author: Joaquin Moreno

reviews.title: Great Cooling, Reasonable Price
reviews.comment: This cooler keeps my 7800X3D well cooled, never throttling. Its a fantastic cooler for the price, not quite Noctua level but surely much closer than the price might lead you to believe. I can't hear anything from inside my case over my earbuds (aside from the occasional ramp up of my gpu) and any noise is usually unnoticed during high load gaming. One complaint is the way I had to orientate my fans, I wish I could have mounted them to push air through the tower, but due to the location of my ram I instead had to mount behind so its more like they're pulling air through. It wouldn't be the worst thing for a fan to be sitting on top of the ram, but personally I just didn't want to look at it sitting on top like that.
